image.alt: A drawing of four Neolithic stone tools on a flat surface: a polished celt, a ring stone, a saddle quern and a second ring stone, each with a small scale bar.

ring.alt: A drawing of a perforated ring stone, of the kind that may have weighted a digging stick, with a scale bar.

quern.alt: A Neolithic saddle quern: a large rough lower stone with a curved depression worn into its upper surface, beside a small hand-stone used to grind grain against it.

pot.alt: A hand-built earthenware Neolithic storage pot, rounded body, narrow neck and a flat rim, fired in muted orange-brown clay.
